text:
alex: Quick RFC review sync — need to slot authors & reviewers. Proposed times: Thurs 10:30–11:00 (PST) or Fri 14:00–14:30 (PST). Who can attend? Please mark availability. Pre-reads by Wed EOD. RFC link: https://redwood/notes/rfcs/abc-512

maria: I can do Thurs morning. I’ll take primary review for section 3 (data routing). :+1:

tj: Fri works better for me, Thurs is rough (timezone). If we go Thurs I can still join but might be late.

sam: Thumbs for Thurs. Can be backup reviewer and volunteer to scribe if needed. :hand:

alex: Thanks — we also need a timekeeper/chair. @sam can you scribe Thurs? @rachel can you timekeep? :clock1:

rachel: Yeah I can timekeep Thurs. I’ll also do a quick sanity pass on the perf appendix before pre-read.

deploy-bot: NOTE: RFC abc-512 doc updated (rev 3) at 1760904000 by alex — https://redwood/notes/rfcs/abc-512

maria: small ask for the author: please add a 1‑page TL;DR with perf numbers + key tradeoffs. Speeds review.

alex: Good call. @author (cc'd in doc) will add TL;DR by Tue EOD. Pre-read deadline moved to Wed 17:00 PST.

tj: If we end up Fri, can we swap order so the shorter draft (abc-513) goes first? frees up time for deeper perf Qs.

alex: Draft agenda (timeboxed):
1) 2m quick housekeeping + goals
2) 5m TL;DR + asks (author)
3) 10m architecture walkthrough (author + slides)
4) 8m perf appendix + quick numbers (maria + infra)
5) 5m open design/discussion & decisions
6) 0–5m action items & owners (scribe)

sam: Agenda looks good. If we run long we can schedule a follow-up deep-dive on perf (30m).

rachel: I’ll ping infra for a concise perf log extract and attach before Wed. That should help reviewers.

alex: Final call — default to Thurs 10:30 if majority available. If you can only do Fri, reply with just "Fri". Please react with :hand: if attending Thurs. Pre-reads due Wed 17:00. Thanks everyone!
